It also monitors tach. It has an I2C interface for external control/monitoring. It has an ISP header for programming. It has a power switch for the fan, possibly to turn it off completely. - PB3: potentiometer input (ADC)
- PB4: tach input (interrupt)
- PB1: PWM output to fan
- PB0, PB2: I2C (SDA, SCL) and also ISP MOSI, SCK
